| Artha | Job board | partial | `POST api.arthajobboard.com/client/api/v1/jobs/search/guest (tenant from the browser Origin header; not used) + {tenant}.arthajobboard.com/jd/1/sitemap.xml -> /job-detail/{slug} (Cloudflare challenge, 403)` | `{tenant}.arthajobboard.com`<br>`{tenant}.arthajobboard.com/job-detail/{slug}` | allowed | untested | no | Blocked (2026-11-10; blocked_by_site.yaml). Artha Job Board (Knovator Technologies) is a multi-tenant Next.js SaaS on {tenant}.arthajobboard.com (unknown tenants redirect to /client-not-found); arthajobboard.com answers again (TLS failed on 2026-11-08). Vendor demo board demo.arthajobboard.com (robots.txt Allow: /, sitemap /jd/1/sitemap.xml with 312 job URLs) and a customer board medskil.arthajobboard.com (282 job URLs, mostly placeholder tech titles) were found, but every job page answers 403 with a Cloudflare challenge (cf-mitigated: challenge) to our User-Agent. The listing API is POST api.arthajobboard.com/client/api/v1/jobs/search/guest and picks the tenant from the browser Origin header; without it every call (incl. /robots.txt) returns {code: INVALID_CLIENT}. Faking the Origin header is not done. artha.linkx (lead) does not resolve: .linkx is not a TLD; 'Artha Link' is a product feature on arthajobboard.com. |
| CSOD | ATS | partial | `POST {company}.csod.com/services/x/career-site/v1/search (bearer token from page)` | `{company}.csod.com/ux/ats/careersite/{n}/home?c={company}`<br>`{company}.csod.com/ats/careersite/JobDetails.aspx?id={id}` | allowed | untested | no | Not built: blocked (coverage/blocked_by_site.yaml). robots.txt allows everything (Crawl-delay: 10). The career site (/ux/ats/careersite/{n}/home?c={corp}) and requisition pages are 5 KB JS shells; jobs come only from POST /services/x/career-site/v1/search with the bearer token in csod.context.token (401 without it on americares and ymca, 2026-11-08). No sitemap (/sitemap.xml 404, careersite sitemap redirects to login), legacy JobDetails.aspx/search.aspx redirect to the shell. |
| JobBoardFire | Job board | unknown | `{board}.jobboardfire.com (HTML)` | `{board}.jobboardfire.com`<br>`{board}.jobboardfire.com/c/{company-slug}`<br>`custom domains` | allowed | untested | no | productmarketing.jobboardfire.com returned HTTP 403 to our User-Agent (2026-11-07): bot protection. |
| talentReef | ATS | partial | `apply.jobappnetwork.com/clients/{clientId} (React SPA, 751-byte shell); data from POST prod-kong.internal.talentreef.com/apply/proxy-es/search-en-us/posting/_search (Elasticsearch query, filter clientId.raw)` | `apply.jobappnetwork.com/clients/{clientId}`<br>`apply.jobappnetwork.com/clients/{clientId}/posting/{jobId}[/{locale}]`<br>`apply.jobappnetwork.com/{templateURL}` | allowed | untested | no | Not built: blocked (coverage/blocked_by_site.yaml, scope platform). Owner decision 2026-11-08: the internal host is not used, so there is no public listing. Career pages are a JS shell (sitemap.xml 403); the production app bundle sends its job search, without any token, to an Elasticsearch proxy at prod-kong.internal.talentreef.com/apply/proxy-es/{search-en-us\|search-fr-ca\|search-es-us}/posting/_search (robots.txt 404). One GET ?size=1 returned 200 with full postings (title, HTML description, address, brand, clientId/clientName, contractType, internalOrExternal; 190,608 hits in the index). The host is named internal and takes arbitrary Elasticsearch queries, so it was used for that one request only. The public site filters by clientId.raw (+ brand.raw, location.id) and, for external candidates, internalOrExternal = externalOnly. |

## Research gaps

14 todo platforms have fewer than 2 verified example boards: Artha, CSOD, CareerSiteCloud, Dayforce, Dover, JobBoardFire, Paycom, Paycor, Talenetic, UltiPro, eJobBoard, ejobsitesoftware.com, jobBoardHQ, talentReef.

"Verified" means the endpoint and examples answered a live request on that date; "no" means the entry comes from documentation or prior knowledge and must be re-checked before implementation. "Generic" = whether the generic sitemap/RSS + schema.org JobPosting approach worked on the evaluated boards (`scripts/evaluate_generic.py`).
